name: widget-fold-on-click
description: Click a widget frame's title row to fold it to one line: pi-goal-x's goal dashboard, the beads in-progress box, and the pi-lens diagnostics pane. Adds folding at pi's widget-API boundary (setWidget factory wrap) without touching any upstream package; /fold is the keyboard path and the regular-tuiMode fallback. Required because pi-goal-x has no mouse handling and beads/lens slot owners expose no fold knob.
